gaps.note: The paper (line 1331) states both deficits are greater than 20*2^{-50}, not 20*2^{-40}. With 2^{-40} the claim is stronger than the paper and false: eta_b = 339/22587335000000 is about 1.5e-11, while 20*2^{-40} is about 1.8e-11. The later step 1-20*2^{-50} > 1-eta also only needs 2^{-50}.

The chain says exp(-2^{-50} ln mu) < 1-20*2^{-50}, which is the wrong direction and is false (exp(-x) > 1-x, and ln mu < 20 gives exp(-2^{-50} ln mu) > exp(-20*2^{-50}) > 1-20*2^{-50}). The paper (lines 1334-1336) has m^{1-2^{-50}} = m exp(...) > m(1-20*2^{-50}) > m(1-eta). The chain with < then > also proves nothing about mu^{-2^{-50}} versus 1-eta; it should read > 1-20*2^{-50} > 1-eta.

The page never gives the matrix size mu of the explicit network, so the reader cannot check mu<2^20. The paper has m=h^3=1000000 (line 656), which is below 2^20. The step ln mu<20 also uses ln 2<1, which is not said.
